C1446.title: Exodus Explanation of Replay Attacks After Blockchain Forks
C1446.summary: Exodus updated its replay-attack explanation in 2024. After a blockchain hard fork, if the old and new chains do not implement replay protection, the same signed transaction may be valid on both chains. An attacker can copy a transaction broadcast on one chain and submit it on the other, causing assets that the user intended to move on only one branch to be transferred on both.
